vocabulary.meaning_en: the things you feel when you are sick, like a headache or a fever
vocabulary.note_ar: المفرد: symptom، والـ p تُنطق خفيفة
vocabulary.example: What are your symptoms?

vocabulary.meaning_en: when liquid keeps coming out of your nose
vocabulary.example: I have a cold and a runny nose.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to push air out of your throat with a loud noise
vocabulary.example: He coughed all night.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a body temperature that is higher than normal
vocabulary.example: The child has a high fever.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a cold is a mild illness with a runny nose; the flu is stronger, with fever and pain
vocabulary.note_ar: have a cold / have the flu
vocabulary.note_en: have a cold / have the flu
vocabulary.example: I think it's the flu, not just a cold.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you take to get better when you are sick
vocabulary.example: Take your medicine after dinner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: another word for medicine
vocabulary.note_ar: قد تعني أيضًا مخدّرات، والسياق يحدّد المعنى
vocabulary.note_en: It can also mean an illegal substance; context shows the meaning.
vocabulary.example: This drug helps with pain.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a paper from a doctor that says which medicine you need
vocabulary.example: The doctor wrote me a prescription.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a shop where you get medicine
vocabulary.note_ar: في كندا وأمريكا يقال أيضًا drugstore
vocabulary.example: Is there a pharmacy near here?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a pharmacy that also sells things like toothpaste and baby products
vocabulary.example: I bought toothpaste at the drugstore.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the person in a pharmacy who gives out medicine
vocabulary.example: Ask the pharmacist about side effects.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to prepare and give the medicine on a prescription
vocabulary.example: The pharmacist filled my prescription in ten minutes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (medicine) you can buy without a prescription
vocabulary.example: You can buy this over-the-counter drug without a prescription.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sleepy; a medicine that makes you sleepy
vocabulary.example: This medicine may make you drowsy, so don't drive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an arrangement where a company pays for your medical costs
vocabulary.example: Do you have an insurance plan?

vocabulary.meaning_en: one small piece of medicine you swallow
vocabulary.note_ar: نقول How many pills وليس How many drugs
vocabulary.note_en: Say "How many pills?", not "How many drugs?"
vocabulary.example: Take two pills with water.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the small paper on a bottle with information and instructions
vocabulary.example: Read the label before you take the medicine.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how much medicine to take and how often
vocabulary.example: The dosage is one pill twice a day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: unwanted things a medicine can do to you, like making you tired
vocabulary.example: One side effect is feeling sleepy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a pain in your head
vocabulary.example: I have a terrible headache.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a pain in your back
vocabulary.note_ar: back pain كلمتان، backache كلمة واحدة
vocabulary.example: Sitting all day gives me a backache.

fine_lines.title: pain vs ache
fine_lines.explanation_ar: pain وache بنفس المعنى (ألم). مع pain نكتب كلمتين: back pain, head pain. ومع ache كلمة واحدة: backache, headache, stomachache.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Pain and ache mean the same. With pain we write two words (back pain); with ache one word (backache, headache).

fine_lines.title: drowsy vs non-drowsy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الدواء drowsy يجعلك ناعسًا فلا تقُد السيارة. الدواء non-drowsy لا يسبّب النعاس.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A drowsy medicine makes you sleepy, so don't drive. A non-drowsy medicine does not.

examples.sentence: Take the drowsy pill before bed.
I need a non-drowsy medicine for work.

fine_lines.title: prescription vs over-the-counter
fine_lines.explanation_ar: بعض الأدوية تحتاج prescription من الطبيب. وأدوية over-the-counter تشتريها من الصيدلي مباشرة بدون وصفة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Some medicines need a doctor's prescription. Over-the-counter medicines can be bought without one.

examples.sentence: You need a prescription for these pills.

fine_lines.title: medicine / drug vs pill
fine_lines.explanation_ar: medicine أو drug هو الدواء عمومًا. pill هي الحبّة الواحدة التي تبلعها.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Medicine or drug is the general word. A pill is one small piece you swallow.

examples.sentence: This medicine is for your cough.
Take one pill in the morning.

expressions.meaning_en: What do you feel? What is wrong?
expressions.example: What are your symptoms? - I have a fever and a cough.

expressions.phrase: The doctor wrote me a prescription.
expressions.meaning_en: The doctor gave me a paper for medicine.
expressions.example: The doctor wrote me a prescription for my cough.

expressions.phrase: Will this medicine make me drowsy?
expressions.example: I have to drive. Will this medicine make me drowsy?

expressions.phrase: Do you have an insurance plan?
expressions.meaning_en: Does a company pay for your medicine?
expressions.example: Do you have an insurance plan? - Yes, here is my card.

expressions.phrase: Can I help you with something?
expressions.example: Good morning. Can I help you with something?

expressions.meaning_en: Asking for help to find something.
expressions.example: Can you help me find something for a headache?
The label says: take with food.

questions.question: What does the doctor ask first?
questions.explanation_en: The doctor asks about your symptoms first.

questions.question: A paper from the doctor that says which medicine you need is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A prescription is the doctor's paper for medicine.

questions.question: "Over-the-counter" medicine ___.
questions.explanation_en: You can buy it without a prescription.

questions.question: This medicine makes you sleepy. It is ___.
questions.explanation_en: Drowsy means it makes you sleepy.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: "I have a terrible ___."
questions.explanation_ar: headache كلمة واحدة، أو head pain كلمتان.
questions.explanation_en: Headache is one word (or head pain, two words).

questions.question: The person who gives you medicine in a pharmacy is the ___.
questions.explanation_en: The pharmacist works in the pharmacy.

questions.question: "How much and how often should I take it?" This is about the ___.
questions.explanation_en: Dosage is how much and how often.

questions.question: In Canada and the US, another word for pharmacy is ___.
Which question is correct?
choices: How many drugs do you take?
How many pills do you have to take?
How many medicine do you take?
How many prescription do you take?
questions.explanation_en: We count pills: How many pills?
